## Workshop — Trace Explorer

Use the panels below to investigate. Open a trace waterfall to find the bugs. The root span name is **`http post /transfers/prepare`** (auto-named by Micrometer). Use `duration > Xs` to filter by the span's own duration.

### 1 — All transfer requests

Sort by **Duration** to spot outliers.

---

**[Open in Explore →](/explore?orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22tempo-workshop%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22traceql%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%7B%20resource.service.name%20%3D%20%5C%22transfer-service%5C%22%20%26%26%20name%20%3D%20%5C%22http%20post%20/transfers/prepare%5C%22%20%7D%22%2C%22limit%22%3A50%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-15m%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D)**

### 2 — Slow requests (> 2s)

Filters on the HTTP request span duration. Use this to find the bug.

---

**[Open in Explore →](/explore?orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22tempo-workshop%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22traceql%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%7B%20resource.service.name%20%3D%20%5C%22transfer-service%5C%22%20%26%26%20name%20%3D%20%5C%22http%20post%20/transfers/prepare%5C%22%20%26%26%20duration%20%3E%202s%20%7D%22%2C%22limit%22%3A20%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-15m%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D)**

### 3 — Async background jobs

Background jobs (settle / reconcile / receipt) run after the response returns. Tagged `job.async = true`.

---

**[Open in Explore →](/explore?orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22tempo-workshop%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22traceql%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%7B%20resource.service.name%20%3D%20%5C%22transfer-service%5C%22%20%26%26%20span.job.async%20%3D%20true%20%7D%22%2C%22limit%22%3A20%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-15m%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D)**

### TraceQL reference

```
{ resource.service.name = "transfer-service"
  && name = "http post /transfers/prepare"
  && duration > 2s }
```

```
{ resource.service.name = "risk-service"
  && span.risk.screening_terms_checked > 0 }
```
